# Seattle ProWash
> Professional roof cleaning, moss removal, and gutter cleaning serving the Greater Seattle area. Based in Kenmore, WA. Founded 2022 by Dylan Thornsberry. 224 5-star Google reviews. Licensed WA contractor #SEATTPL783M6, bonded ($30K) and insured ($1M liability). 12-month moss-free guarantee.

## Owner
Dylan Thornsberry, founder and operator since 2022. Based at 6516 NE 192nd Pl, Kenmore, WA 98028. Phone: 206-752-6690.

## Core Services
- [Roof Cleaning](https://www.seattleprowash.com/roof-cleaning): Soft-wash moss removal for asphalt, metal, and flat roofs. $499-$1,200 depending on size. Includes eco-friendly zinc sulfate treatment. 12-month moss-free guarantee.
- [Gutter Cleaning](https://www.seattleprowash.com/gutter-cleaning): Hand-scoop debris removal, downspout flush, and roof blow-off. Starting at $250.
- [Moss Treatment](https://www.seattleprowash.com/moss-treatment): Preventive zinc sulfate treatment to stop moss regrowth. Biodegradable and safe for plants.
- [Pressure Washing](https://www.seattleprowash.com/pressure-washing): Driveways, patios, decks, siding, and walkways.
- [Window Cleaning](https://www.seattleprowash.com/window-cleaning): Exterior window cleaning with streak-free results.
- [Commercial Services](https://www.seattleprowash.com/commercial): Building washing, roof maintenance, and gutter cleaning for commercial properties.

## Service Areas
Primary: Kenmore (home base), Lake Forest Park, Bothell, Kirkland, Lynnwood, Shoreline
Secondary: Seattle, Woodinville, Bellevue, Redmond, Sammamish, Edmonds, Mill Creek, Mountlake Terrace
